description:
This file defines an abstract test case class for integration testing of API endpoints within the OrangeHRM project. It includes utility methods for fixture management, test case retrieval, mock setup, validation, and service registration, specifically tailored for testing API endpoints.

Key distinguishing features include its namespace 'OrangeHRM\Tests\Util', its inheritance from EndpointTestCase, and methods related to fixture and test case management.

classes.name: EndpointIntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration tests of API endpoints, providing utility methods for fixtures, mocking, validation, and service setup.

methods.name: populateFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixtures data into the test environment from specified fixture files.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Fetches and constructs test case parameters from fixture files for use in tests.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMock
methods.description: Creates a mock object of the specified API endpoint class with configured request parameters.

methods.name: assertValidTestCase
methods.description: Validates the API response against expected test case parameters, including exception handling, validation rules, and result assertions.

methods.name: assertServicesInitialized
methods.description: Checks whether the expected services and factories are properly initialized.

methods.name: registerServices
methods.description: Registers service dependencies in the mock container based on test case parameters.

methods.name: getMockAuthUser
methods.description: Creates a mock authenticated user object based on test case parameters.

methods.name: registerMockDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mocked DateTimeHelperService with a fixed current time if specified.
